messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - inference-queue backlog > 10k for service=redwood-inference/hosted-api. Autoscaler hasn't increased capacity for ~6m. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345
PagerDuty: PD12345 triggered by metric: queue_length > 10000, avg_latency > 800ms. Paging oncall.
Meera: acked. I'm on it.
Jon: seeing a bunch of errors from scale-controller: `Rate limited creating pods: 429 Too Many Requests` and `failed to create node: quota exceeded` in the cluster events.
Carlos: metrics look weird — HPA metrics-server reporting stale metrics, CPU reported zero for inference-worker pods for last 5m while queue backlog shows steady arrival. Could be metrics scrape timeout.
Meera: grabbing logs and checking controller-manager. Jon, can you try a manual scale meanwhile? If kube API is rate-limiting, maybe we need to scale nodes instead of pods.
Jon: running manual steps now:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=30
kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -n inference -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":50}}'
```
Jon: first command returned `Scaled` but pods are Pending with `failed to schedule` because node capacity full. Getting `Insufficient cpu` in pod events.
Dana: we have a spare dedicated GPU pool in eu-west that can be used for emergency routing. Might be faster to spin up nodes there and shift some traffic.
Meera: good call. I'm going to toggle routing policy to send 20% of new requests to eu-west-dedicated. Doing a temporary routing rule in console.
Carlos: also increasing cluster autoscaler max nodes. Patch applied: `--nodes=3:100` -> new max 120. That should let cloud provider provision nodes; watching for scale events.
Jon: cloud provider is provisioning new instances, but it's taking ~3-5m per node. In the meantime queue is still growing, current queue_length=12784.
Meera: PagerDuty, ack by Meera (primary).
PagerDuty: PD12345 acknowledged by Meera.
IncidentBot: :warning: Escalation timer hit 4m, notifying Sr-SRE.
Dana: Sr-SRE here. What do you need?
Meera: just approved cross-region routing and manual scale. We also need to relieve some backpressure: can we temporarily throttle low-priority tenant traffic?
Dana: yes — enabling tenant rate-limits for non-paid tiers to 0.5x. Patch pushed.
Jon: after manual node additions and routing shift, new pods are becoming Running. Pod startup logs show worker init complete. Queue drain rate jumped from ~120 req/s to ~650 req/s. queue_length now 8300.
Carlos: looks like metrics-server recovered at 1845123700, HPA now sees real CPU and will scale automatically.
Meera: good. I'm leaving the routing rule and throttles for 15m while we confirm drain. Also creating an incident page for follow-up: impact = increased latency & partial rate-limiting for non-paid tenants.
Jon: creating a temporary alert suppression for duplicate autoscale alerts so we don't get paged repeatedly while we stabilize.
Dana: adding action items: 1) postmortem for scale-controller rate limit & metrics-server outage, 2) add warm pool to reduce cold-provision time, 3) test cross-region failover runbook.
Meera: monitoring — queue_length trending down, currently 3421. Will mark as mitigated once <500 and SLOs in range.
IncidentBot: PD12345 auto-note: Mitigation in progress, oncall Meera.
PagerDuty: closing PD12345? (needs manual close)
Meera: not closing yet. Will update when <500.
Jon: beside autoscaler, logs show a brief spike in control-plane API calls from a controller loop iterating fast after a retry storm. Need to throttle that loop.
Carlos: agreed. I'll open a PR to add jitter + backoff to the scale-controller loop.
Meera: thanks all, handoff to follow-up owners: Carlos (scale-controller fix), Dana (warm pool ops), Jon (runbook + autoscaler tuning). I'll stay as incident lead and handle comms.
Dana: noted.
Meera: queue_length now 412. Starting to remove temporary throttles and routing after 2m stable.
Meera: final update: queue drained, avg latency back to ~120ms, no customer-facing errors reported after throttling. Marking incident mitigated and will create postmortem ticket.
Jon: :thumbsup:
Carlos: filing postmortem draft.
Meera: incident mitigated — leaving PD alert as closed by Meera at 1845123890. Thanks team.
